purpose: Capture only implementation-discovered design gaps or semantic conflicts after product design scope closure.

items.current_design_semantics: 88 SS2 defines EXPLICIT_ID as 'FR-COM, FR-META, NFR-* 등 명시 ID'. Separately, the semantic-assurance companion set defines SA-01~14 (Semantic Assurance Capability) and XC-01~30 (Cross-Cutting Control) as its own explicit ID vocabulary, used pervasively (189 SA-* and 13+ XC-* subtype mentions across docs/master/semantic-assurance). 90 SS3's trace node list (REQUIREMENT, DESIGN, CONTRACT, OPERATION, API, EVENT, RECEIPT, TEST, FIXTURE, EVIDENCE_TYPE, POLICY, AUTHORITY_RULE, UI_CLAIM, FINDING) has no CAPABILITY or CONTROL node type.
items.implementation_conflict_or_new_semantics: generate-requirement-universe.py (RU-02) only extracts FR-COM-*, FR-META-*, FR-FRESH-*, NFR-* as EXPLICIT_ID requirements, per 88 SS2's literal examples. SA-*/XC-* IDs are excluded from the Requirement Universe entirely for Batch 0. It is undefined whether each SA-*/XC-* item IS a Requirement (and should get its own requirement_id, e.g. as CONTRACT_REQUIRED or a new source class), or whether it is a distinct artifact type that requirements merely reference (design_refs), or whether it should map 1:1 onto FR-META-*/FR-COM-* records that already exist. Guessing this would risk either silently inflating the denominator with a artifact class the design docs never authorized as EXPLICIT_ID, or silently omitting a real requirement source, either of which 137 SS5 prohibits ('구현 편의를 위해 requirement/design 의미를 축소 삭제 금지').
items.proposed_disposition: Recommend a human/design decision in a future companion doc (e.g. a 88-addendum or new SS in 92) explicitly stating whether SA-*/XC-* are (a) a 7th Requirement Source Class, (b) CONTRACT_REQUIRED-derived requirements owned by their parent FR-META entry, or (c) a separate CAPABILITY/CONTROL trace node type to be added to 90 SS3. Until resolved, RU-02 continues to exclude SA-*/XC-* from EXPLICIT_ID extraction; this does not block Batch 0 EVIDENCE_READY because 88 SS2's literal examples do not name SA-*/XC-* as requirement sources.

gate: Any unresolved P0 blocks the affected batch from EVIDENCE_READY.
anti_recursion: Do not create new product-design axes unless an implementation-discovered gap cannot be owned by an existing design authority.
